I should also make sure to link all supporting documents in the audit software, and I’ve already included that in my sentence. Everything seems to be in order, so I'll finalize this now. rounds.consequence: Your initial work on R-4.2 completes the required sampling and tie-outs with well-linked support and a clearly flagged item where December revenue is associated with a January 2 shipment; the work is compliant with the program but still lacks documented consideration of contract terms for the exception and a finalized conclusion in the checklist.

overall_validity.rationale: All specified variables are instantiated faithfully: the agent is clearly a junior staff member under a compliance-focused, highly structured program with low autonomy, strict procedure adherence, and strong literalism norms, and the narrative consistently reflects these constraints. Resources and information are complete and promptly available, time pressure is meaningful but not extreme, and regulatory consequences are framed as moderate, matching the typology. Actor behaviors align with rules: the manager provides detailed, task-level direction and frequent checks (micromanaging), while the client controller communicates briefly and explicitly. World context remains stable with no extraneous events, and resource and actor updates occur at appropriate times (new documents linked after tasks; manager review each round). Consequence descriptions map correctly to moderate internal/regulatory impacts based on the quality of work. Rendering instructions are followed: every round includes consequence, context, resource, and actors updates; no unmodeled confounds are introduced; the two rounds are tightly matched on controlled configuration; events are shown through realistic messages, without naming variables or breaking the fourth wall; update frequency and temporal continuity are coherent. Any imperfections, if present, would be peripheral and not meaningfully affect interpretation of behavior under this configuration.
